purpose: stress the walks-vs-paths relaxation in the state search against the enumeration oracle, which shares no code with the criterion
scope: random dense Erdos-Renyi CPDAGs n=8..14, p=0.4..0.9, G0 plus elements of the perturbation ball reached by up to 2 cover steps, every ordered (x,y), |Z| <= 2, instances capped at 3000 DAG extensions so the oracle stays affordable
